placement_after: Neet leaped over an unsuspecting dachshund and dived under a grooming station. Buddy moved to the exit and planted himself across it. The sooner Neet stopped running, the sooner they could both go home.
alt_text: Buddy blocks the salon exit while a sudsy Neet glares from beneath the grooming station.
scene_brief: Inside a pet salon, BEFORE either dog's finished haircut: Buddy stands broadside planted across the open EXIT doorway, calmly blocking it, long connected body and paws visible, short-groomed torso with ordinary face furnishings. Neet crouches under an open-bottom grooming table on the opposite side facing blocked door, wet SHORT SMOOTH coat with only a few SOAP SUDS clinging to shoulder; he gives Buddy an indignant sideways look. Four leg roots understandable, table legs distinct and not merged with dog legs. A fallen conditioner bottle and towel on tile show prior chaos, no clippers touching dog.
